akame.title: Akame ga Kill!
akame.synopsis: Tatsumi leaves his village hoping to support its people and becomes involved with a group fighting a corrupt empire. His new allies force him to confront the dangers and moral costs of rebellion.

assassination-2.title: Assassination Classroom 2nd Season
assassination-2.synopsis: Class 3-E returns to school with its unusual mission still unfinished: assassinate the teacher who is helping its students succeed. New rivals and personal challenges test the class as its deadline approaches.

danganronpa.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
danganronpa.sourceTitle: Danganronpa: Kibou no Gakuen to Zetsubou no Koukousei The Animation
danganronpa.synopsis: Makoto enters an elite academy only to discover that its students are trapped in a deadly game. Escaping requires a murder, and uncovering the culprit becomes a matter of survival.

demon-slayer.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
demon-slayer.synopsis: After demons attack his family, Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps. He searches for a way to restore his sister Nezuko's humanity while facing increasingly dangerous opponents.

haikyuu-3.title: Haikyuu!! 3rd Season
haikyuu-3.sourceTitle: Haikyuu!! Karasuno Koukou vs. Shiratorizawa Gakuen Koukou
haikyuu-3.synopsis: Karasuno faces powerhouse Shiratorizawa in the match that will decide its place at nationals. Hinata and his teammates must bring together everything they have learned against an imposing opponent.

hunter.title: Hunter x Hunter
hunter.synopsis: Gon takes the dangerous Hunter Examination in the hope of following his father's path. The friends he makes along the way draw him into a world of challenging adventures and extraordinary abilities.

promised-neverland.title: The Promised Neverland
promised-neverland.synopsis: Life at Grace Field House seems peaceful for its young residents. When its oldest children uncover a disturbing secret, they must question everything they believed about their home.

tokyo-ghoul.title: Tokyo Ghoul
tokyo-ghoul.synopsis: A disastrous encounter changes student Ken Kaneki into a human-ghoul hybrid. He struggles to preserve his identity while learning to survive between two hostile worlds.

arrietty.title: The Secret World of Arrietty
arrietty.synopsis: Tiny Arrietty lives beneath a house, borrowing small necessities from its human occupants. Her friendship with a visiting boy puts her family's carefully hidden way of life at risk.

weathering.title: Weathering With You
weathering.synopsis: Runaway Hodaka arrives in a rain-soaked Tokyo and meets Hina, a girl who can bring sunshine. Their attempt to make a living with her gift reveals that changing the weather has consequences.

spirited-away.title: Spirited Away
spirited-away.synopsis: Chihiro wanders into a mysterious spirit world and must work in a bathhouse to survive. With unexpected allies, she searches for a way to rescue her parents and return home.

one-piece.title: One Piece
one-piece.synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy sets sail in pursuit of the legendary One Piece treasure. He gathers an unusual crew and faces dangerous seas, powerful rivals, and new adventures on the way to becoming Pirate King.

charlotte.title: Charlotte
charlotte.synopsis: Yuu uses a brief possession ability to get ahead at school until another student exposes him. Joining a school for young ability users brings responsibilities and mysteries he never expected.

hello-world.title: Hello World
hello-world.synopsis: A reserved student in futuristic Kyoto meets a man claiming to be his older self. The stranger urges him to change a tragedy involving a classmate, setting a complicated plan in motion.

your-name.title: Your Name
your-name.synopsis: A countryside girl and a Tokyo boy begin waking up in each other's bodies. Their attempts to understand the experience draw their lives together across distance and unexpected circumstances.

angels-of-death.title: Angels of Death
angels-of-death.synopsis: Rachel awakens inside a strange building with no memory of how she arrived. An uneasy alliance with a dangerous man becomes her only way through its threatening floors.

classroom-elite.title: Classroom of the Elite
classroom-elite.sourceTitle: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e
classroom-elite.synopsis: A prestigious school divides students into classes with unequal privileges. Ayanokoji and his classmates must navigate its ruthless competition to improve their standing.

kiki.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
kiki.synopsis: Young witch Kiki leaves home for a year of independent living with her cat Jiji. Starting a broomstick delivery service helps her discover responsibility, friendship, and her place in a new town.

totoro.title: My Neighbor Totoro
totoro.synopsis: Two sisters move to the countryside while their mother receives hospital treatment. Discovering a gentle forest spirit brings wonder and comfort into their new daily lives.

noragami.title: Noragami
noragami.synopsis: Minor god Yato takes odd jobs while dreaming of a devoted following. An accident connects him with Hiyori, whose unusual condition draws her into his supernatural world.

another.title: Another
another.synopsis: A transfer student finds his classmates behaving strangely toward a quiet girl with an eyepatch. A series of unsettling events leads him to investigate the secret surrounding their class.

death-parade.title: Death Parade
death-parade.synopsis: A mysterious bar receives people after death and tests them through revealing games. Its arbiter begins to question his judgments when an unfamiliar visitor changes his perspective.

mugen-train.title: Demon Slayer: The Movie — Mugen Train
mugen-train.sourceTitle: Kimetsu no Yaiba Movie: Mugen Ressha-hen
mugen-train.synopsis: Tanjiro and his companions join Flame Hashira Rengoku to investigate disappearances aboard a train. A hidden demonic threat puts the passengers and their rescuers in danger.

erased.title: Erased
erased.synopsis: Satoru's ability to revisit moments before disaster sends him back to his childhood. He tries to prevent a classmate's disappearance while unraveling a mystery connected to the present.

haikyuu.title: Haikyuu!!
haikyuu.synopsis: Determined volleyball player Hinata joins Karasuno and discovers that his former rival Kageyama is now his teammate. Learning to work together becomes essential to rebuilding their team's reputation.

haikyuu-2.title: Haikyuu!! 2nd Season
haikyuu-2.synopsis: Karasuno prepares for the next tournament by training alongside formidable rival teams. Hinata, Kageyama, and their teammates work to strengthen their skills and develop new approaches.

haikyuu-top.title: Haikyuu!! To the Top
haikyuu-top.synopsis: With nationals ahead, Karasuno's players face new training opportunities and personal challenges. Hinata looks for his own way to improve while his teammates refine their abilities.

haikyuu-top-2.title: Haikyuu!! To the Top 2nd Season
haikyuu-top-2.synopsis: Karasuno's national tournament journey continues against increasingly demanding opponents. The team must adapt under pressure to keep its ambitions alive.

jujutsu-kaisen.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
jujutsu-kaisen.synopsis: Yuji Itadori is drawn into a hidden world of curses and sorcerers. Training alongside other students, he faces supernatural threats while carrying a dangerous power within him.

iruma.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
iruma.synopsis: Iruma is sold to a demon who unexpectedly adopts him as a grandson. Attending a demon school means navigating strange traditions while hiding the fact that he is human.

iruma-2.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun 2nd Season
iruma-2.synopsis: Iruma grows more comfortable at demon school and begins pursuing a higher rank. New responsibilities in the student council bring unusual challenges and unexpected trouble.

assassination.title: Assassination Classroom
assassination.synopsis: An overlooked class receives an extraordinary assignment: kill its nearly unstoppable new teacher before he destroys Earth. His dedication to teaching complicates the students' unusual mission.

entertainment-district.title: Demon Slayer: Entertainment District Arc
entertainment-district.synopsis: Tanjiro's group accompanies Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui into the entertainment district. A search for missing allies leads them toward a dangerous demon hiding among its bustling streets.

iruma-3.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun 3rd Season
iruma-3.synopsis: Iruma and his classmates must improve their ranks to keep their special classroom. New tutors and demanding school festivals give them a chance to prove their progress.

tangerines.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
tangerines.synopsis: On Jeju Island, a spirited young woman and a dependable young man build a life together. Their story follows love, family, and perseverance across the challenges of passing years.

while-sleeping.title: While You Were Sleeping
while-sleeping.synopsis: A woman dreams of future accidents, and a prosecutor becomes involved in trying to prevent them. Their shared efforts raise questions about whether tragedy can truly be changed.

graceful-family.title: Graceful Family
graceful-family.synopsis: An heiress and a lawyer investigate the truth behind her mother's death. Their work brings them into conflict with the secrets protecting a powerful family.

attorney-woo.title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
attorney-woo.synopsis: Young attorney Woo Young-woo brings exceptional legal insight to her first professional cases. Alongside courtroom challenges, she navigates relationships and the expectations of her workplace.

mr-queen.title: Mr. Queen
mr-queen.synopsis: A modern man's soul unexpectedly becomes trapped in the body of a Joseon-era queen. Adjusting to palace life means facing unfamiliar customs, royal intrigue, and an unusual identity crisis.

dear-x.title: Dear X
dear-x.synopsis: Successful actress Baek Ah-jin hides a manipulative personality behind her polished public image. The relationships and sacrifices behind her rise reveal a darker side of fame.

alice-borderland.title: Alice in Borderland
alice-borderland.synopsis: A gamer and his friends find themselves in a deserted version of Tokyo. Surviving its dangerous games forces them to use their wits and question the rules of their new reality.

unwritten-seoul.title: Our Unwritten Seoul
unwritten-seoul.synopsis: Twin sisters with very different lives exchange identities after an unexpected turn of events. Each must face unfamiliar responsibilities while discovering what she truly wants.

perfect-crown.title: Perfect Crown
perfect-crown.synopsis: A wealthy heiress lacks the status that society values, while a prince has status without freedom. A contract marriage offers both a way to challenge the expectations shaping their lives.

hells-kitchen-vegas.title: Hell's Kitchen: Las Vegas
hells-kitchen-vegas.synopsis: Aspiring chefs compete in a demanding Las Vegas kitchen for a major career opportunity. Team challenges and intense dinner services test their skill, discipline, and ability to handle pressure.

hells-kitchen-ages.title: Hell's Kitchen: Battle of the Ages
hells-kitchen-ages.synopsis: Chefs from different age groups compete through culinary challenges and high-pressure dinner services. Their contrasting experience and approaches become part of the battle for a life-changing prize.

enola-holmes.title: Enola Holmes
enola-holmes.synopsis: Sherlock Holmes's younger sister sets out to find her missing mother. Her journey to London intersects with a runaway young nobleman and a mystery larger than she expected.

enola-holmes-2.title: Enola Holmes 2
enola-holmes-2.synopsis: Enola returns for another detective adventure alongside her famous brother. Seeking to establish herself independently, she becomes involved in a new mystery.

witch.title: The Witch: Part 1. The Subversion
witch.synopsis: A young woman with an unusual past becomes entangled in the consequences of experiments on human abilities. Her connection to a dangerous organization threatens the life she has built.

ready-or-not.title: Ready or Not
ready-or-not.synopsis: A bride's wedding-night introduction to her husband's wealthy family becomes a deadly ritual. She must survive their twisted tradition before the night is over.

infinity-castle.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle
infinity-castle.sourceTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – The Movie: Infinity Castle
infinity-castle.synopsis: The Demon Slayer Corps enters Muzan's shifting fortress for a confrontation with its most dangerous enemies. The battle brings its members face to face with the remaining Upper Rank demons.

weightlifting.title: Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo
weightlifting.synopsis: A young weightlifter navigates training, friendship, and first love alongside fellow student athletes. Their ambitions and everyday struggles shape a warm coming-of-age story.

ready-or-not-2.title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
ready-or-not-2.sourceTitle: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
ready-or-not-2.synopsis: Grace is pulled into another deadly ritual immediately after her first ordeal. This time, protecting her estranged sister means surviving the pursuit of several powerful families.
